title: Oven-Roasted Moroccan Chicken Khle'a
description: A sweet and spicy Moroccan-inspired dish featuring crispy chicken, rum, and a crunchy spice blend. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil and rum. Add the spice blend and mix until well combined.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Arrange the chicken thighs on the baking sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is crispy.
While the chicken is cooking, mix together brown sugar and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
After the chicken is cooked, brush the brown sugar-parsley mixture onto the top of each thigh.
Return the chicken to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the glaze is set.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the chicken into serving portions and serve hot.
